name: N,N-dimethyletonitazene
summary: N,N-Dimethyletonitazene is an opioid analgesic drug which has been sold as a designer drug, first detected in Latvia in May 2024, and subsequently identified in China. It is far less potent than etonitazene, but still has a potency some 20x that of morphine.

uses.text: N,N-Dimethyletonitazene is an opioid analgesic drug which has been sold as a designer drug, first detected in Latvia in May 2024, and subsequently identified in China.

pharmacology.en: Like other nitazenes, it acts on the μ-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine and fentanyl. It is far weaker than etonitazene but still much stronger than morphine.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他尼他嗪一樣，它作用於 μ 型鴉片受體，與嗎啡和吩坦尼的作用目標相同。它比依托尼他嗪弱得多，但仍比嗎啡強很多。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他尼他嗪一样，它作用于 μ 型鸦片受体，与吗啡和吩坦尼的作用目标相同。它比依托尼他嗪弱得多，但仍比吗啡强很多。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Nitazenes are very potent, so overdose is a serious risk, and reversing it may need more than one dose of naloxone.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。尼他嗪類藥效極強，過量的風險很高，逆轉過量時可能需要不只一劑納洛酮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。尼他嗪类药效极强，过量的风险很高，逆转过量时可能需要不只一剂纳洛酮。

fact.en: The nitazenes, the benzimidazole opioids it belongs to, were first made in the 1950s by the Swiss drug company Ciba, but none was ever approved as a medicine.
fact.zh: 它所屬的苯并咪唑類鴉片「尼他嗪」（nitazenes）最早由瑞士藥廠汽巴（Ciba）在 1950 年代合成，但從未有任何一種被核准為藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它所属的苯并咪唑类鸦片「尼他嗪」（nitazenes）最早由瑞士药厂汽巴（Ciba）在 1950 年代合成，但从未有任何一种被核准为药物。
